verdict.rationale: Persona documents pre-creating inquiries server-side via API, hosted flows requiring no frontend code, embedded/drop-in flows for web and mobile, combined government-ID plus selfie (liveness) verification within a single inquiry template, and webhooks/polling to read final results. This covers the full story: server-side session creation, redirect or embed, and result retrieval without building capture UI. missing for 10: no independent/hands-on developer report confirming the end-to-end flow works as documented, and no explicit code sample showing the exact API call sequence for creating a session and reading results.
